title: The @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0 npm package contains malware
summary: GitHub identifies exactly @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0 as malicious and advises treating installations as fully compromised. No patched version is listed.

severity.rationale: A malicious installed dependency exposes developer and CI environments and their secrets. Supply chain compromise and credential exposure warrant containment within 72 hours.

affected.note: Exactly 13.3.0. No patched version is listed in the inspected advisory.

exposure: Relevant to environments that installed or ran the named release, including transitive installation. This record does not establish affected Swarm Desktop builds.

params.instructions: Inspect lockfiles, caches and installation history for @ethersphere/bee-js exactly 13.3.0 without executing the package.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Remove the package and replace exposed secrets and keys from a separate trusted system. Removal alone may leave other malicious software behind.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating and restarting can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the malicious package is absent and exposed secrets were replaced; package removal alone does not establish recovery.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
